title: Cover-relative effacement stable under inverse image
statement: For a scheme morphism g : Y → X [def-pc-scheme], an open cover U of X and a family V of opens of Y with every nonempty V-tuple intersection contained in the preimage of its U-tuple intersection, every abelian sheaf F has a short exact sequence T with T.X₁ = F. Its quotient map is surjective on all U-tuple sections, the inverse image quotient map [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] is surjective on all V-tuple sections, and every connecting map from degree q of T.X₃ to degree q+1 of F is surjective.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1 and Tag 01EQ; assigned unit-comparison node proof, Step 1, relative effacement

proof.text: Apply exists_cechCoverRelativeEffacement_core to U, hcover and F, obtaining T, its short exactness, U-tuple section surjectivity, local splitting on each U_i and surjective connecting maps.

For k and y : Fin(k+1) → ι take W = U(y(0)). The assumed hinter bounds the V-tuple intersection by the preimage of the U-tuple intersection; monotonicity of preimage and iInf_le at 0 bound this by g⁻¹(W). Apply inverseImage_surjective_sections_of_localSplit to T, W and that V-tuple intersection, using the local split monomorphism supplied by the core. Assemble the original unchanged conclusion. If ι is empty there are no y; every other tuple has its first index 0.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cechCoverRelativeEffacement
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ∃ (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})),
      T.X₁ = F ∧ ∃ (hT : T.ShortExact)
        (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
          Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))),
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
          Function.Surjective (((invImage g).map T.g).hom.app (op (⨅ l, V (y l))))) ∧
        ∀ q, Function.Surjective (TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q)
